external-blink.title: 외부 LED 깜빡이기
external-blink.code: const int LED=13; void setup(){pinMode(LED,OUTPUT);} void loop(){digitalWrite(LED,HIGH);delay(500);digitalWrite(LED,LOW);delay(500);}

button-led.title: 버튼으로 LED 켜기
button-led.code: const int BTN=2, LED=13; void setup(){pinMode(BTN,INPUT_PULLUP);pinMode(LED,OUTPUT);} void loop(){digitalWrite(LED,digitalRead(BTN)==LOW);}

rgb-cycle.title: RGB LED 색 순환
rgb-cycle.code: const int pins[]={9,10,11}; void setup(){for(int p:pins)pinMode(p,OUTPUT);} void loop(){for(int i=0;i<3;i++){analogWrite(pins[i],255);delay(500);analogWrite(pins[i],0);}}

servo-sweep.title: 서보 스윕
servo-sweep.code:
#include <Servo.h>
Servo servo; void setup(){servo.attach(9);} void loop(){for(int a=0;a<=180;a++){servo.write(a);delay(15);}for(int a=180;a>=0;a--){servo.write(a);delay(15);}}

melody.title: 피에조 멜로디
melody.code: int notes[]={262,330,392,523}; void setup(){} void loop(){for(int n:notes){tone(8,n,250);delay(300);}delay(500);}

seven-count.title: 7세그먼트 0–9 카운트
seven-count.code: const byte digits[10]={0x3F,0x06,0x5B,0x4F,0x66,0x6D,0x7D,0x07,0x7F,0x6F}; const int pins[]={2,3,4,5,6,7,8}; void setup(){for(int p:pins)pinMode(p,OUTPUT);} void loop(){for(int n=0;n<10;n++){for(int s=0;s<7;s++)digitalWrite(pins[s],bitRead(digits[n],s));delay(1000);}}

neopixel-rainbow.title: NeoPixel 무지개
neopixel-rainbow.code:
#include <Adafruit_NeoPixel.h>
Adafruit_NeoPixel strip(8,6,NEO_GRB+NEO_KHZ800); void setup(){strip.begin();strip.show();} void loop(){for(int j=0;j<256;j++){for(int i=0;i<8;i++)strip.setPixelColor(i,strip.gamma32(strip.ColorHSV((i*65536L/8+j*256)&65535)));strip.show();delay(20);}}
